mapper.select: SELECT id, login_id, password_hash, account_type, organization_type FROM account WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT CASE phone_code WHEN 'dev-precinct-cmd-phone-01' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000201' WHEN 'dev-precinct-car-01' THEN '50000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' WHEN 'dev-precinct-phone-01' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000101' WHEN 'dev-alpha-cmd-phone-01' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000204' WHEN 'dev-alpha-phone-01' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000205' WHEN 'dev-support-cmd-phone-01' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000206' WHEN 'dev-support-car-01' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000207' WHEN 'dev-support-phone-01' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000208' ELSE CAST(id AS VARCHAR) END AS id, phone_code, account_id FROM police_phone WHERE phone_code = #{phoneCode} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_token ( id, account_id, police_phone_id, channel, token_hash, expires_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{accountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{policePhoneId,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{channel}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.sql: rt.id AS session_id, a.id AS account_id, rt.police_phone_id, rt.channel, a.account_type, a.organization_type
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM refresh_token rt JOIN account a ON a.id = rt.account_id LEFT JOIN police_phone pp ON CAST(pp.id AS VARCHAR) = CAST(rt.police_phone_id AS VARCHAR) WHERE rt.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND rt.revoked_at IS NULL AND rt.expires_at > #{now} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (rt.police_phone_id IS NULL OR pp.status = 'ACTIVE')

SELECT
FROM refresh_token rt JOIN account a ON a.id = rt.account_id LEFT JOIN police_phone pp ON CAST(pp.id AS VARCHAR) = CAST(rt.police_phone_id AS VARCHAR) WHERE rt.id = #{sessionId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND rt.revoked_at IS NULL AND rt.expires_at > #{now} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (rt.police_phone_id IS NULL OR pp.status = 'ACTIVE')
